draftBefore.shortGloss: to finish; to end; to destroy
draftBefore.emotion: satisfied and relieved after finally completing a long task
notes: A compound verb formed from the Arabic loanword 'खत्म' (finished) and the light verb 'करना' (to do).
Used both for finishing a physical task or consumable and for ending something abstract like a relationship or a conversation.

senses.definition: To bring something to an end or complete a task.

examples.text: मैंने अपना काम खत्म कर लिया है।
examples.emotion: accomplished and glad to be done

senses.definition: To come to the end of something or use up a supply completely.

senses.definition: To cause the death of someone or completely destroy something.
